summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) ProblemSection mobile clipping fix and desktop regression, and (2) new Forgot/Reset Password flow. All 13 assertions passed. Mobile @390x844: section min-height computed 0px, inner wrapper position=relative overflow=visible, 3D bg scene display:none (hidden lg:block honored); all 3 problem cards render fully with no overlap (card0 bottom 778 → card1 top 794; card1 bottom 1128 → card2 top 1145) and complete text including 'GAP · 0X · CLOSED BY VALUEVADE' footers. Screenshots confirm each card is fully readable when scrolled into view. Desktop @1920x1080: section min-height=1836px (~170vh), inner position=sticky, overflow=hidden, bg-scene display=block — parallax pin behavior preserved (regression clean). Forgot Password: /login button now navigates to /forgot-password (no toast); submitting info@valuevade.com and nonexistent-xyz123@example.com both land on the SAME generic 'Check your inbox' sent-state (no account enumeration leak). Back-to-Sign-In link routes back to /login. Reset Password: visiting /reset-password directly shows the verifying spinner briefly, then falls back to the 'Link expired' invalid-state; 'Request a new link' button navigates to /forgot-password. Regression: admin login info@valuevade.com / aa1aa2sam3 succeeds and lands on /dashboard.
action_items: IMPORTANT (config, cannot verify from code): Confirm Supabase Auth → URL Configuration → 'Redirect URLs' allow-list includes BOTH https://fintech-mvp-38.preview.emergentagent.com/reset-password AND https://valuevade.com/reset-password so the emailed recovery link actually lands on the right page. This must be done in the Supabase dashboard.

The full happy-path (email link → PASSWORD_RECOVERY session → new password → login) requires actually reading the info@valuevade.com inbox and was NOT executed to avoid changing production credentials. Recommend a manual round-trip once redirect URLs are confirmed in the Supabase dashboard.

Minor UX consideration (not a bug): on /reset-password direct-visit, the 'verifying' spinner shows for ~2.5s before falling back — acceptable, but if you want faster feedback, consider also inspecting URL hash for absence of 'access_token' / 'type=recovery' to short-circuit the wait.
critical_code_review_comments: ResetPasswordPage.jsx: the 2500ms timeout is a reasonable fallback but if PASSWORD_RECOVERY event fires AFTER the timeout (slow networks), the invalid-state could show incorrectly. Consider also checking session presence continuously or extending the timer to 4-5s.

ForgotPasswordPage: error is displayed verbatim from supabase (setError(err.message)) — for the anti-enumeration promise to hold end-to-end, consider swallowing rate-limit or user-not-found errors and always showing the sent-state (currently we did not observe any such error since Supabase resetPasswordForEmail is intentionally generic, but be aware).
ProblemSection.js fix is clean and minimal; lg: prefix strategy correctly leaves desktop untouched.

All new data-testids (forgot-password-*, reset-password-*) verified. Only outstanding item is Supabase dashboard redirect-URL allow-list config which cannot be tested from inside the app.
rca of the issue: Original mobile clipping RCA (confirmed fixed): outer <section> had inline minHeight:170vh always-on, and inner wrapper was always sticky top-0 h-screen overflow-hidden. On mobile the grid stacks vertically (~1450px of cards), which exceeded the 100vh sticky container → overflow-hidden clipped everything below the fold. Fix: gate sticky/overflow-hidden/min-height-170vh + 3D scene behind lg: breakpoint. Verified mobile now uses position:relative, overflow:visible, section height grows naturally (1671px) to fit all cards + copy.
